---
title: "R 语言学习笔记"
title-block-banner: false
listing:
  contents: 
    - "*.rmd"
    - "*.qmd"
    - "00*.md"
    - "!index.qmd"
    - "!sections/*.qmd"
    - "!0001-guide.rmd"
  type: grid
  sort: "date desc" 
  fields: [image, title, description, categories, reading-time]
  grid-item-border: false
  page-size: 18
  grid-columns: 3
  image-height: 180px
toc: true
toc-title: "随机笔记"
include-in-header:
  - text: |
      <style>
      #title-block-header { display: none !important; height: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; }
      main.content { padding-top: 0 !important; margin-top: 0 !important; }
      #quarto-document-content { padding-top: 0 !important; margin-top: 0 !important; }
      .quarto-title-block { display: none !important; }
      section.level1, section.level2 { margin-top: 0 !important; padding-top: 0 !important; }
      .guide-card {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
        border-radius: 16px;
        padding: 2.5rem 3rem;
        margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 3rem;
        box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.5);
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .guide-card::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: -50%;
        right: -10%;
        width: 400px;
        height: 400px;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
        border-radius: 50%;
      }
      .guide-card::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        bottom: -50%;
        left: -10%;
        width: 300px;
        height: 300px;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        border-radius: 50%;
      }
      .guide-info {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        background: transparent !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
        border: none !important;
        width: auto;
        flex: 1;
        text-align: left;
      }
      .guide-info h2 {
        color: white;
        margin: 0 0 0.75rem 0;
        font-size: 2rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        line-height: 1.2;
      }
      .guide-info p {
        color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        line-height: 1.5;
        max-width: 600px;
      }
      .guide-btn {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        background: white;
        color: #667eea !important;
        padding: 0.8rem 2rem;
        border-radius: 50px;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 1rem;
        text-decoration: none !important;
        transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        white-space: nowrap;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      .guide-btn:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
      }
      .hero-section {
        margin: -0.5rem 0 0 0;
        padding: 0.5rem 0 0.3rem 0;
        border-radius: 0;
        background: transparent;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 0.3rem;
        box-shadow: none;
      }
      .hero-title {
        display: none;
      }
      .hero-subtitle {
        display: none;
      }
      .search-wrapper {
        width: min(760px, 100%);
        position: relative;
        z-index: 2;
        margin-top: 1rem;
      }
      .search-container {
        width: 100%;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.4rem;
      }
      /* 优美的长钝椭圆搜索框 */
      .search-box {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 560px;
        height: 52px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        background: #ffffff;
        border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
        border-radius: 26px;
        padding: 0 6px 0 20px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
        transition: all 0.25s ease;
        margin: 0 auto;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 10;
      }
      .search-box:focus-within {
        border-color: #3b82f6;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(59,130,246,0.15);
      }
      .search-icon {
        display: none;
      }
      .search-input {
        flex: 1;
        border: none !important;
        outline: none !important;
        font-size: 1rem;
        background: transparent !important;
        color: #1e293b;
        pointer-events: auto;
        border-radius: 0 !important;
        height: auto !important;
        padding: 0 12px 0 0 !important;
      }
      .search-input::placeholder {
        color: #94a3b8;
      }
      .search-clear {
        display: none;
      }
      .search-btn {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        width: 40px;
        height: 40px;
        border: none;
        background: #3b82f6;
        color: #995e15ff;
        border-radius: 50%;
        cursor: pointer;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        transition: all 0.2s ease;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 11;
      }
      .search-btn i {
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .search-btn:hover {
        background: #2563eb;
        transform: scale(1.05);
      }
      .search-btn:active {
        background: #1d4ed8;

      }
      .content-tabs {

      }
      .content-tab {
        border: none;

        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
        padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
        font-size: 0.9rem;

        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.2s ease;

        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.35rem;
      }
      .content-tab:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
        color: #ffffff;
      }
      .content-tab.active {
        background: #ffffff !important;
        color: #1e293b !important;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
      }
      .content-tab .tab-icon {
        font-size: 0.85rem;
      }

      /* 日间模式 content-tabs 修复 */
      html:not([data-bs-theme="dark"]):not(.quarto-dark) .content-tab {
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
        color: #4b5563;
      }
      html:not([data-bs-theme="dark"]):not(.quarto-dark) .content-tab:hover {
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
        color: #1f2937;
      }
      html:not([data-bs-theme="dark"]):not(.quarto-dark) .content-tab.active {
        background: #1f2937 !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
      }
      .search-results-dropdown {
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(100% + 0.75rem);
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        background: #ffffff;
        border-radius: 16px;
        box-shadow: 0 16px 40px -24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45);
        border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
        max-height: 360px;
        overflow-y: auto;
        opacity: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
        transform: translateY(-8px);
        transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
        z-index: 10;
      }
      .search-results-dropdown.visible {
        opacity: 1;
        pointer-events: auto;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
      .search-result-item {
        display: block;
        padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
        text-decoration: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
        transition: background 0.2s ease;
      }
      .search-result-item:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
      }
      .search-result-item:hover {
        background: #f8fafc;
      }
      .result-header {
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
      }
      .result-section {
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #1d4ed8;
        background: #eff6ff;
        padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem;
        border-radius: 999px;
      }
      .result-title {
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #0f172a;
      }
      .result-snippet {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        color: #64748b;
        line-height: 1.4;
      }
      .search-highlight {
        background: #fef08a;

        padding: 0.05rem 0.15rem;
        border-radius: 2px;
        font-weight: 500;
      }
      .search-filter-bar {
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.25rem;
        padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
        background: #f8fafc;
        border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0;
      }
      .search-filter-btn {
        border: none;
        background: transparent;
        color: #64748b;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
        border-radius: 4px;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.15s ease;
      }
      .search-filter-btn:hover {
        background: #e2e8f0;
        color: #334155;
      }
      .search-filter-btn.active {
        background: #3b82f6;
        color: white;
      }
      @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .hero-section {
        margin: 120px 0 1.5rem 0 !important; /* 大幅增加顶部边距以避免被header遮挡 */
        padding: 1rem 0;
        border-radius: 0;
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        text-align: center;
        gap: 0.75rem;
        box-shadow: none;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
      }
      
      .hero-section h2 {
        font-size: 1.6rem !important; /* 移动端字体稍微调小 */
      }

      .hero-title {
        display: none;
      }
      .hero-subtitle {
        display: none;
      }

        .search-box {
          height: 40px;
          padding: 0 0.65rem;
        }
        .mode-btn {
          font-size: 0.75rem;
        }
      }
      @media (max-width: 768px) {

        .guide-card {
           padding: 1rem 1.2rem;
           flex-direction: row;
           align-items: center;
           justify-content: space-between;
           width: 100%;
           box-sizing: border-box;
           gap: 1rem;
           margin-top: 25% !important;
           border-radius: 12px;
        }
        .guide-info {
           width: auto;
           flex: 1;
           text-align: left;
        }
        .guide-info h2 {
           font-size: 1.1rem;
           margin: 0;
           line-height: 1;

           margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

           display: none !important;
        }
        .guide-btn {
           width: auto;

           font-size: 0.85rem;
           margin: 0;
           margin-top:60%;
        }
      }
      /* 小屏手机 (小于480px) */
      @media screen and (max-width: 480px) {
        .hero-section {
          padding: 1rem 0.75rem !important;
        }
        .search-container {
          padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem !important;

        }

           width: 32px !important;
           height: 32px !important;

        }
      }
      </style>

```{=html}
<script>
// 强制修复 Hypothesis 侧边栏导致的布局问题
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  function fixHypothesisLayout() {
    // 1. 消除 html 和 body 的 margin-right 空隙
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('margin-right', '0', 'important');
    document.body.style.setProperty('margin-right', '0', 'important');
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('width', '100%', 'important');
    document.body.style.setProperty('width', '100%', 'important');
    
    // 2. 隐藏 bucket bar (侧边栏边缘的灰色条)
    const bucketBar = document.querySelector('hypothesis-bucket-bar');
    if (bucketBar) {
      bucketBar.style.display = 'none';
      bucketBar.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
    }

    // 3. 处理 sidebar frame
    const sidebar = document.querySelector('iframe[name="hyp_sidebar_frame"]');
    if (sidebar) {
      // 这里的样式可能无法直接作用于 iframe 内部，但可以控制 iframe 本身的位置
      // 让 sidebar 悬浮在页面之上，而不是挤压页面
    }
  }

  // 立即执行一次
  fixHypothesisLayout();

  // 使用 MutationObserver 监听变化，防止 Hypothesis 脚本重新加上 margin
  const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
    let shouldFix = false;
    for (const mutation of mutations) {
      if (mutation.attributeName === 'style' || mutation.addedNodes.length > 0) {
        shouldFix = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (shouldFix) {
      fixHypothesisLayout();
    }
  });

  // 观察 html 和 body 的 style 变化
  observer.observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] });
  observer.observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'], childList: true });
  
  console.log('[Layout Fix] Hypothesis layout fix applied.');
});
</script>
```

```{=html}
<script>
// 全局变量，供侧边栏使用
window.searchData = [];

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function() {
  // ==================== 搜索功能 ====================
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('homepage-search');
  const searchResults = document.getElementById('homepage-search-results');
  const searchBtn = document.getElementById('search-btn');
  
  let searchData = [];
  
  // 加载搜索数据
  try {
    const response = await fetch('search.json');
    searchData = await response.json();
    // 同步到全局变量
    window.searchData = searchData;
    searchData = searchData.filter(item => {
      const hasTitle = item.title && item.title.length > 0;
      const hasText = item.text && item.text.length > 20;
      const notIndex = !item.href.includes('index.html');
      const notSections = !item.href.includes('sections/');
      return hasTitle && hasText && notIndex && notSections;
    });
    
    // 触发自定义事件通知数据已加载
    console.log('[数据加载] searchData 加载完成, 数据量:', window.searchData.length);
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('searchDataReady', { detail: { data: window.searchData } }));
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('无法加载搜索数据:', error);
  }
  
  // 搜索按钮点击事件
  if (searchBtn) {
    searchBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      console.log('搜索按钮被点击了！', e.target);
      const query = searchInput.value.trim();
      if (query.length >= 2) {
        performSearch(query);
      } else {
        // 如果输入为空，聚焦到输入框
        searchInput.focus();
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 搜索输入
  let currentSearchFilter = 'all';
  
  if (searchInput) {
    // 回车触发搜索
    searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const query = searchInput.value.trim();
        if (query.length >= 2) {
          performSearch(query);
        }
      }
    });
    
    // 点击外部关闭搜索结果
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.search-box') && !e.target.closest('.search-results-dropdown')) {
        searchResults.classList.remove('visible');
      }
    });
  }
  
  // 高亮关键词
  function highlightKeywords(text, keywords) {
    if (!text) return '';
    let result = text.replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
    keywords.forEach(kw => {
      if (kw.length < 2) return;
      const regex = new RegExp(`(${kw.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')})`, 'gi');
      result = result.replace(regex, '<span class="search-highlight">$1</span>');
    });
    return result;
  }
  
  // 执行搜索
  function performSearch(query) {
    const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase();
    const keywords = lowerQuery.split(/\s+/).filter(k => k.length >= 2);
    let results = [];
    
    searchData.forEach(item => {
      const title = (item.title || '').toLowerCase();
      const text = (item.text || '').toLowerCase();
      const section = (item.section || '').toLowerCase();
      const desc = (item.description || '').toLowerCase();
      
      let match = false;
      if (currentSearchFilter === 'all') {
        match = keywords.some(kw => title.includes(kw) || text.includes(kw) || section.includes(kw));
      } else if (currentSearchFilter === 'title') {
        match = keywords.some(kw => title.includes(kw));
      } else if (currentSearchFilter === 'content') {
        match = keywords.some(kw => text.includes(kw));
      } else if (currentSearchFilter === 'abstract') {
        match = keywords.some(kw => desc.includes(kw) || section.includes(kw));
      }
      
      if (match) {
        let snippet = '';
        const searchText = currentSearchFilter === 'abstract' ? (item.description || item.text || '') : (item.text || '');
        const lowerSearchText = searchText.toLowerCase();
        const idx = lowerSearchText.indexOf(keywords[0]);
        if (idx >= 0) {
          const start = Math.max(0, idx - 20);
          const end = Math.min(searchText.length, idx + 80);
          snippet = (start > 0 ? '...' : '') + searchText.substring(start, end) + (end < searchText.length ? '...' : '');
        } else {
          snippet = searchText.substring(0, 80) + '...';
        }
        results.push({
          title: item.title,
          section: item.section || '',
          href: item.href,
          snippet: snippet
        });
      }
    });
    
    results = results.slice(0, 8);
    
    // 渲染过滤栏和结果
    const filterBar = `
      <div class="search-filter-bar">
        <button class="search-filter-btn ${currentSearchFilter === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}" data-filter="all">全部</button>
        <button class="search-filter-btn ${currentSearchFilter === 'title' ? 'active' : ''}" data-filter="title">标题</button>
        <button class="search-filter-btn ${currentSearchFilter === 'content' ? 'active' : ''}" data-filter="content">内容</button>
        <button class="search-filter-btn ${currentSearchFilter === 'abstract' ? 'active' : ''}" data-filter="abstract">摘要</button>
      </div>
    `;
    
    if (results.length > 0) {
      const resultItems = results.map(r => `
        <a href="${r.href}" class="search-result-item">
          <div class="result-header">
            ${r.section ? `<span class="result-section">${highlightKeywords(r.section, keywords)}</span>` : ''}
            <span class="result-title">${highlightKeywords(r.title, keywords)}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="result-snippet">${highlightKeywords(r.snippet, keywords)}</div>
        </a>
      `).join('');
      searchResults.innerHTML = filterBar + resultItems;
    } else {
      searchResults.innerHTML = filterBar + '<div class="search-result-item"><div class="result-snippet">没有找到匹配的结果</div></div>';
    }
    searchResults.classList.add('visible');
    
    // 绑定过滤按钮事件
    searchResults.querySelectorAll('.search-filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        currentSearchFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
        performSearch(searchInput.value.trim());
      });
    });
  }
  
  // ==================== 内容标签切换 ====================
  const contentTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.content-tab');
  const listingContainer = document.querySelector('.quarto-listing-container-grid .list');
  let originalHTML = ''; // 保存原始 HTML
  
  // 保存原始卡片 HTML
  if (listingContainer) {
    originalHTML = listingContainer.innerHTML;
  }
  
  // Fisher-Yates 洗牌算法
  function shuffleArray(array) {
    const arr = [...array];
    for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
    }
    return arr;
  }
  
  // 从文件名推断封面图片路径
  const imageMap = {
    "0001-guide": "images/guide_cover.svg",
    "0011-rmarkdown": "images/guide_cover.svg",
    "0013-positron": "figure/positron-cover.svg",
    "1011-rpac_brucer": "figure/bruceR-cover.png",
    "1012-comparegroups": "figure/comparegroups-cover.png",
    "1013-scitb": "images/gt-cover.svg",
    "1014-future": "images/1014_cover.svg",
    "1014-purrr": "figure/default-cover1.png",
    "1015-health-economics": "figure/health-economics-cover.png",
    "1016-mlr3": "figure/mlr3-cover.png",
    "1017-timeseries": "figure/timeseries-cover.png",
    "1018-psm": "figure/psm-cover.svg",
    "1019-logistic": "figure/logistic-cover.png",
    "1020-survival": "figure/survival-cover.png",
    "1021-linear-regression": "figure/linear-regression-cover.png",
    "1022-meta-analysis": "figure/meta-analysis-cover.png",
    "1023-mediation": "figure/mediation-cover.png",

  function getImagePath(href) {
    if (!href) return '';
    const cleanHref = href.split('#')[0];
    const basename = cleanHref.replace('.html', '').replace('.rmd', '').replace('.qmd', '');
    return imageMap[basename] || `images/${basename}-cover.svg`;
  }

  
  // 从 searchData 生成卡片 HTML
  function generateCard(item) {
    const href = item.href || '#';
    const title = item.title || '无标题';
    const section = item.section || '';
    const text = item.text || '';
    const desc = text.replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').substring(0, 100) + '...';
    const imagePath = getImagePath(href);
    
    return `
      <div class="quarto-grid-item card h-100 card-left borderless">
        <p class="card-img-top">
          <img loading="lazy" src="${imagePath}" class="thumbnail-image card-img" style="height: 180px;" onerror="this.parentElement.style.display='none'">
        </p>
        <a href="${href}" class="quarto-grid-link">
          <div class="card-body post-contents">
            <h5 class="no-anchor card-title listing-title">${title}</h5>
            ${section ? `<div class="listing-categories"><div class="listing-category">${section}</div></div>` : ''}
            <div class="card-text listing-description delink">${desc}</div>
          </div>
        </a>
      </div>
    `;
  }
  
  contentTabs.forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      contentTabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      tab.classList.add('active');
      
      const sortMode = tab.dataset.sort;
      if (!listingContainer) return;
      
      if (sortMode === 'recent') {
        // 最近更新 - 恢复原始顺序
        listingContainer.innerHTML = originalHTML;
      } else if (sortMode === 'hot' || sortMode === 'random') {
        // 热门/随机 - 从所有教程中随机抽取
        if (searchData.length === 0) {
          listingContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="p-3 text-muted">暂无数据</div>';
          return;
        }
        
        // 随机抽取 18 个教程
        const shuffled = shuffleArray(searchData);
        const selected = shuffled.slice(0, 18);
        
        // 生成卡片
        listingContainer.innerHTML = selected.map(item => generateCard(item)).join('');
      }
    });
  });
  
  // ==================== 随机笔记侧边栏 ====================
  const tocNav = document.querySelector('#TOC') || document.querySelector('.toc');
  if (!tocNav) return;

  tocNav.innerHTML = `<div class="random-tip-sidebar"><div class="tip-header">📚 随机笔记</div><div class="tip-desc">加载中...</div></div>`;

  try {
    const sections = searchData.filter(item => item.section && item.section.length > 0);
    
    if (sections.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('没有找到有效章节');
    }

    const section = sections[Math.floor(Math.random() * sections.length)];
    
    let content = (section.text || '')
      .replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, '')
      .replace(/##[^\n]*/g, '')
      .replace(/\|[^\n]*\|/g, '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim();
    
    if (content.length > 150) {
      content = content.substring(0, 150).trim() + '...';
    }
    
    const articleTitle = section.title || '笔记';
    
    tocNav.innerHTML = `
      <div class="random-tip-sidebar">
        <div class="tip-header">📚 随机笔记</div>
        <div class="tip-section">${section.section}</div>
        <div class="tip-desc">${content}</div>
        <div class="tip-from">—— ${articleTitle}</div>
        <div class="tip-actions">
          <a href="${section.href}" class="tip-btn">阅读详情 →</a>
          <span class="tip-refresh" onclick="location.reload()">🎲 换一篇</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  } catch (error) {
    tocNav.innerHTML = `
      <div class="random-tip-sidebar">
        <div class="tip-header">📚 随机笔记</div>
        <div class="tip-desc">请在服务器环境下查看随机笔记功能</div>
        <div class="tip-actions">
          <a href="1011-rpac_brucer.html" class="tip-btn">浏览教程 →</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }
});

// 分类标签颜色区分
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  function applyCategoryColors() {
    const categories = document.querySelectorAll('.listing-category');
    categories.forEach(cat => {
      const text = cat.textContent.trim();
      
      // 实用R包 - 蓝色系
      if (text.includes('实用R包') || text.includes('表格制作') || text.includes('数据处理') || text.includes('模型整理') || text.includes('模型解释')) {
        cat.style.backgroundColor = '#dbeafe';
        cat.style.color = '#1e40af';
      }
      // 可视化教程 - 紫色系
      else if (text.includes('可视化') || text.includes('统计图表') || text.includes('图形') || text.includes('美化') || text.includes('ggplot')) {
        cat.style.backgroundColor = '#ede9fe';
        cat.style.color = '#5b21b6';
      }
      // R语言方法 - 绿色系
      else if (text.includes('R语言方法') || text.includes('回归') || text.includes('生存分析') || text.includes('因果推断') || text.includes('机器学习') || text.includes('建模') || text.includes('XGBoost') || text.includes('TMLE')) {
        cat.style.backgroundColor = '#dcfce7';
        cat.style.color = '#166534';
      }
      // 实用操作 - 橙色系
      else if (text.includes('实用操作') || text.includes('数据输入') || text.includes('工作流程') || text.includes('数据预处理')) {
        cat.style.backgroundColor = '#ffedd5';
        cat.style.color = '#c2410c';
      }
      // 入门指南 - 青色系
      else if (text.includes('入门') || text.includes('指南') || text.includes('基础')) {
        cat.style.backgroundColor = '#ccfbf1';
        cat.style.color = '#0f766e';
      }
      // 默认样式
      else {
        cat.style.backgroundColor = '#f3f4f6';
        cat.style.color = '#4b5563';
      }
      
      // 通用样式
      cat.style.padding = '0.2rem 0.6rem';
      cat.style.borderRadius = '4px';
      cat.style.fontSize = '0.75rem';
      cat.style.fontWeight = '500';
      cat.style.marginRight = '0.25rem';
      cat.style.display = 'inline-block';
    });
  }
  
  // 初始应用
  applyCategoryColors();
  
  // 监听分页变化
  const observer = new MutationObserver(applyCategoryColors);
  const listing = document.querySelector('.quarto-listing');
  if (listing) {
    observer.observe(listing, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }
});

// ==================== 自定义侧边栏卡片 ====================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  // DEBUG: console.log('[侧边栏] DOMContentLoaded 触发');
  
  // 监听 searchData 加载完成事件
  window.addEventListener('searchDataReady', function(event) {
    // DEBUG: console.log('[侧边栏] 接收到 searchDataReady 事件, 数据量:', event.detail.data.length);
    initializeSidebar();
  });
  
  // 轮询检查 searchData 是否加载(最多等待5秒)
  let checkCount = 0;
  const maxChecks = 50; // 50 * 100ms = 5秒
  
  const checkDataInterval = setInterval(() => {
    checkCount++;
    
    if (window.searchData && window.searchData.length > 0) {
      // DEBUG: console.log('[侧边栏] searchData 已加载,开始初始化');
      clearInterval(checkDataInterval);
      initializeSidebar();
    } else if (checkCount >= maxChecks) {
      // DEBUG: console.error('[侧边栏] 超时: searchData 未在5秒内加载');
      clearInterval(checkDataInterval);
    }
  }, 100); // 每100ms检查一次
});

let sidebarInitialized = false; // 防止重复初始化

function initializeSidebar() {
  if (sidebarInitialized) {
    // DEBUG: console.log('[侧边栏] 已经初始化过,跳过');
    return;
  }
  
  // 立即标记为已初始化，防止竞态条件
  sidebarInitialized = true;
  // DEBUG: console.log('[侧边栏] 开始初始化侧边栏...');
  
  const marginSidebar = document.querySelector('#quarto-margin-sidebar');
  if (!marginSidebar) {
    // DEBUG: console.warn('[侧边栏] 找不到 #quarto-margin-sidebar 元素');
    return;
  }

  const isSectionPage = window.location.pathname.includes('/sections/');
  const resolvePath = (path) => {
    if (isSectionPage) {
      if (!path.startsWith('sections/')) return '../' + path;
      return path.replace('sections/', '');
    }
    return path;
  };

  // 获取随机推荐(不重复)
  function getRandomItems(arr, count) {
    const shuffled = [...arr].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
    return shuffled.slice(0, Math.min(count, arr.length));
  }

  // ==================== 精选教程卡片 ====================
  function renderFeatured(container) {
      // DEBUG: console.log('[精选教程] 开始渲染...');
      
      // 使用全局 filteredData 或重新过滤
      const dataToUse = window.filteredDataGlobal || window.searchData.filter(item => item && item.title && item.href && item.title.length > 0);
      // DEBUG: console.log('[精选教程] 可用数据长度:', dataToUse.length);
      
      // 动态获取推荐数据
      const items = getRandomItems(dataToUse, 3);
      // DEBUG: console.log('[精选教程] 随机选取的教程数:', items.length);
      
      if (items.length === 0) {
        // DEBUG: console.warn('[精选教程] 没有可用数据,显示占位内容');
        container.innerHTML = `
          <div class="sidebar-card-header">
            <span class="header-icon"><i class="bi bi-star"></i></span> 精选教程
          </div>
          <div class="featured-list">
            <div style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; color: #64748b;">
              正在加载教程数据...
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }
      
      const cardsHtml = items.map(item => {
        const starCount = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2) + 2;
        const stars = Array(starCount).fill('<i class="bi bi-star-fill"></i>').join('');
        const tags = ['热门', '推荐', '精选', '必读'];
        const tag = tags[Math.floor(Math.random() * tags.length)];
        
        return `
        <a href="${resolvePath(item.href)}" class="featured-item">
          <div class="featured-header">
            <span class="featured-tag">${tag}</span>
            <span class="featured-difficulty">${stars}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="featured-title">${item.title}</div>
        </a>
      `}).join('');
      
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="sidebar-card-header">
          <span class="header-icon"><i class="bi bi-star"></i></span> 精选教程
          <span class="refresh-btn" title="换一批" id="refresh-featured"><i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i></span>
        </div>
        <div class="featured-list">
          ${cardsHtml}
        </div>
      `;
      
      // DEBUG: console.log('[精选教程] 渲染完成');

      const refreshBtn = container.querySelector('#refresh-featured');
      if (refreshBtn) {
        refreshBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          refreshBtn.style.transform = 'rotate(360deg)';
          setTimeout(() => {
            refreshBtn.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)';
            renderFeatured(container);
          }, 300);
        });
      }
    }
    
  const customSidebarContainer = document.createElement('div');
  customSidebarContainer.className = 'custom-sidebar-cards';

  // ==================== 学习路径卡片 ====================
  const learningPathHtml = `
    <div class="sidebar-card learning-path">
      <div class="sidebar-card-header"><span class="header-icon"><i class="bi bi-compass"></i></span> 学习路径</div>
      <div class="learning-levels">
        <a href="${resolvePath('0001-guide.html')}" class="level-item level-beginner">
          <span class="level-badge">入门</span>
          <span class="level-desc">从零开始学 R</span>
        </a>
        <a href="${resolvePath('sections/packages.html')}" class="level-item level-intermediate">
          <span class="level-badge">进阶</span>
          <span class="level-desc">掌握实用 R 包</span>
        </a>
        <a href="${resolvePath('sections/statistics.html')}" class="level-item level-advanced">
          <span class="level-badge">高级</span>
          <span class="level-desc">统计建模分析</span>
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  // ==================== 本周必学卡片 ====================
  const essentialTopics = [
    { title: '学习路线规划', href: '0001-guide.html', tag: '必读', icon: 'bi bi-map' },
    { title: 'ggplot2 可视化入门', href: '2032-ggplot2-intro.html', tag: '基础', icon: 'bi bi-bar-chart' },
    { title: 'dplyr 数据处理', href: '3003-dplyr-tidyr.html', tag: '核心', icon: 'bi bi-wrench' },
    { title: 'Logistic 回归', href: '1019-logistic.html', tag: '统计', icon: 'bi bi-calculator' }
  ];
  
  const essentialsHtml = `
    <div class="sidebar-card essentials">
      <div class="sidebar-card-header"><span class="header-icon"><i class="bi bi-fire"></i></span> 本周必学</div>
      <div class="essentials-list">
        ${essentialTopics.map(topic => `
          <a href="${resolvePath(topic.href)}" class="essential-item">
            <span class="essential-icon"><i class="${topic.icon}"></i></span>
            <div class="essential-content">
              <div class="essential-title">${topic.title}</div>
              <span class="essential-tag">${topic.tag}</span>
            </div>
          </a>
        `).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  // ==================== 精选教程卡片 ====================
  const featuredCard = document.createElement('div');
  featuredCard.className = 'sidebar-card featured';
  
  // 组装所有卡片
  customSidebarContainer.innerHTML = learningPathHtml + essentialsHtml;
  customSidebarContainer.appendChild(featuredCard);
  
  // DEBUG: console.log('[侧边栏] 卡片HTML已组装');
  
  // 先将侧边栏添加到页面 (重要: 必须在更新数据之前!)
  const toc = marginSidebar.querySelector('#TOC') || marginSidebar.querySelector('nav');
  if (toc) {
    toc.after(customSidebarContainer);
    // DEBUG: console.log('[侧边栏] 已插入到 TOC 之后');
  } else {
    marginSidebar.appendChild(customSidebarContainer);
    // DEBUG: console.log('[侧边栏] 已添加到 marginSidebar');
  }
  
  // DEBUG: 验证DOM元素是否存在
  // console.log('[侧边栏] 验证DOM元素:');
  // console.log('  - stats-total:', !!document.getElementById('stats-total'));
  // console.log('  - stats-topics:', !!document.getElementById('stats-topics'));
  // console.log('  - stats-level:', !!document.getElementById('stats-level'));
  // console.log('  - count-viz:', !!document.getElementById('count-viz'));
  
  // 现在DOM已存在,可以渲染内容
  // DEBUG: console.log('[侧边栏] 开始渲染内容...');
  // DEBUG: console.log('[侧边栏] window.searchData 长度:', window.searchData ? window.searchData.length : 0);
  
  if (window.searchData && window.searchData.length > 0) {
    const currentData = window.searchData.filter(item => item && item.title && item.href && item.title.length > 0);
    // DEBUG: console.log('[侧边栏] 过滤后数据长度:', currentData.length);
    
    if (currentData.length > 0) {
      window.filteredDataGlobal = currentData;
      renderFeatured(featuredCard);
      // DEBUG: console.log('[侧边栏] 内容渲染完成!');
    }
  }
  
  // DEBUG: console.log('[侧边栏] 初始化完成!');
}
</script>
```
